editorial.tldr: DeepSeek's retrained V4-Flash overtook the company's own flagship V4 Pro on nine agent benchmarks in late July. A refreshed "V4 Pro 0813" build then quietly appeared on OpenRouter with no official announcement, and an early hands-on called its multimodal quality solid.
editorial.whats_new: DeepSeek has now officially confirmed the V4 Pro release — Reuters and other outlets report the Aug 12 OpenRouter build as a deliberate expansion move, not an unannounced side release.
editorial.why_it_matters: The confirmation closes the gap between DeepSeek's unannounced API drops and its public messaging, but the agent-benchmark question from July's Flash-beats-Pro result is still untested against this build — pin the exact release date, not just "V4 Pro," until DeepSeek ships a changelog.
editorial.take_for_builders: Re-run your agent benchmark against the now-officially-confirmed V4 Pro 0813 build rather than trusting July's Flash-beats-Pro result to still hold, and watch for the changelog DeepSeek still hasn't published.

status.detail: DeepSeek confirmed the V4 Pro 0813 build as an official release two days after it appeared unannounced on OpenRouter.
